title: Connect Tinglan to Codex App Server
summary: Implemented localhost Codex App Server bridge using ChatGPT-managed login, Luna low streamed notes and cited Q&A. Notes are persisted by the frontend; ephemeral Codex threads do not promise desktop-sidebar history. All tools and approvals are denied.
acceptanceCriteria: The browser never receives or stores ChatGPT OAuth tokens or API keys.
The user can complete ChatGPT-managed Codex login and see account/rate-limit state.
The default notes model is gpt-5.6-luna with low reasoning and streamed output.
A transcript produces structured summary, assignments, deadlines, exam points, and timestamped citations.
Free-form questions return answers grounded only in the selected course recordings.
Offline, unauthenticated, quota-limited, cancelled, and server-restart states are recoverable and truthful.
npm run check and npm run build pass.
evidence: 2026-09-07 UTC: node --test tests/bridge/bridge.test.mjs: 7 passed (input/citations, missing login, cancellation, process restart, tool denial, concurrency, Host/Origin/CSRF, NDJSON). These are mock/logic tests.

2026-09-07 UTC: actual Codex CLI 0.153.4 ChatGPT Pro account -> gpt-5.6-luna low returned real synthetic-classroom notes in 16.6 seconds with 166 streamed deltas; concept, 500-word assignment deadline, October20 09:00 exam, and source timestamps validated.
Real cited question answering completed and reported absent resit date instead of inventing it. Initial word-count translation ambiguity prompted explicit unit-preservation instruction.
Real adversarial transcript smoke passed: 0 tool lifecycle/request events, no credential disclosure, assignment source/timestamp correct, 500-word unit preserved.
npm run check and npm run build passed. Fresh interactive login URL completion was not re-run because the existing ChatGPT-managed login already authenticated; no logout or secret copying occurred.
Frontend final-site end-to-end integration remains RELEASE-001 responsibility. This task does not implement ASR, browser recording or UI persistence.
